maker: Fraunhofer IIS and the MPEG group
summary: The compressed audio format from Germany's Fraunhofer Institute, part of the MPEG-1 standard. It made music small enough to share online and set off Winamp, Napster and the iPod.

events.note: A near-final draft of the MPEG-1 standard is made public.
MPEG-1 Audio, including Layer III, is published as ISO/IEC 11172-3.

events.label: .mp3
events.note: The Fraunhofer team picks the .mp3 file extension.

events.label: Winamp
events.note: The Winamp player makes MP3 popular on PCs.

events.label: Napster
events.note: Napster launches, built on sharing MP3 files.

events.label: Patent free
events.note: The last relevant US patent expires.
